input.overview: Hot Line and add-a-ball Big Strike advance their central letter ladder by completing the currently lit rollover buttons. Light A and B to open the gate, then send the ball up a side and through that gate for another letter. Avoid forcing the ball between the bumpers; the wider outside routes offer the more repeatable progress.
input.simpleOverview: In Hot Line or Big Strike, complete the lit rollover buttons to advance one letter. Light A and B to open the gate, then shoot up a side and through the open gate for another letter. Favor the outside paths instead of the gap between the bumpers. Big Strike replaces replay awards with add-a-ball thresholds.
input.summary: Treat every lit-button group as the current objective. A completed group advances the next letter, while A-B opens a repeatable gate route. The bottom outlanes can advance a letter only when lit, but they still end the ball, so use them as a consolation rather than a target.

quickInfo.name: Lit buttons
quickInfo.summary: Complete every currently lit rollover button to advance the next letter.

quickInfo.name: Open the gate
quickInfo.summary: Light A and B, then shoot through the open gate to advance another letter.

quickInfo.name: Lit outlanes
quickInfo.summary: Either bottom outlane advances a letter while lit, but the ball still drains.

quickInfo.name: Copy boundary
quickInfo.summary: Hot Line uses replay or point conversions; Big Strike is the add-a-ball copy with adjustable score thresholds.

steps.text: On the plunge, aim for a lit rollover button and note the other lamps in the current group.
Shoot up either outside path and nudge upper rebounds across the remaining lit buttons.
Complete A and B to open the gate.
Send the ball through the open gate to advance the next letter, then repeat the newly lit button group.
Do not aim for a lit bottom outlane; accept its letter advance only when the ball cannot be saved.

buildsToward.title: Repeated letter advances through the open gate

steps.text: Light A and B to open the gate.
Shoot the outside gate route and begin the next lit group.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use small side nudges above the bumpers to steer the ball across lit buttons or toward the open gate without driving it into the center gap.

machineSetup: Identify replay Hot Line versus add-a-ball Big Strike, confirm ball count, Special or Extra Ball conversion, and Big Strike's installed score thresholds.
Test every rollover button and lamp, A and B qualification, gate opening and reset, letter step unit and display, lit outlane advances, bumpers, and tilt behavior.
